_comment: Optional Cursor MCP stubs — copy entries into .cursor/mcp.json after setting env vars. Do NOT invent API keys. Product Google/Telegram tools on CranL stay primary; these are local Cursor extras.

google-workspace._docs: https://github.com/taylorwilsdon/google_workspace_mcp — requires uv (uvx). Prefer native Gmail/Sheets in ArabicBuzz product.

google-workspace-remote._docs: Self-hosted Streamable HTTP URL after you deploy workspace-mcp. Set MCP_GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_URL.

telegram-chigwell._docs: https://github.com/chigwell/telegram-mcp — clone repo, uv sync, then point --directory at the clone. Userbot (my.telegram.org). Product bot (grammy) remains primary.

github-official._docs: https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server — Docker image ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server. Current active server remains @modelcontextprotocol/server-github in mcp.json.
